title: Crispy New Potato Hash Bites (Vegan)
description: A Chinese-inspired vegan appetizer made from crispy new potato hash bites. Perfect as a snack or appetizer. Crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside.
instructions: Grate the new potatoes and mix with hash brown.
Add soy sauce, maple syrup, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the potato mixture. Mix well.
Using a spoon, drop the mixture into small balls and flatten slightly into patties.
Heat vegan oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the patties to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Transfer the patties to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until crispy.
